title: IVT-Log-Analyzer Output
description: IVT analysis result including fraud patterns, flagged IPs, and GAB compliance verdict.

estimated_ivt_percentage.description: Percentage of requests classified as Invalid Traffic. Formula: (ivt_requests / total_requests) * 100, rounded to 2 decimal places. Range: 0.0 – 100.0.

compliance_status.description: GAB compliance verdict based on IVT threshold. Approved: IVT < 5%. Warning: IVT 5–20%. Rejected: IVT > 20%. Thresholds defined by Google Authorized Buyer (GAB) requirements.

fraud_patterns_detected.description: Deduplicated list of forensic fraud pattern strings. Includes headless UA detections, datacenter IP origins, behavioral anomalies, IP concentration patterns, and GAB non-compliance statement (when Rejected). Empty array if no patterns detected.

flagged_ips.description: Deduplicated list of IP addresses that appear in at least one IVT-flagged request. Empty array if no IPs flagged.
